confirm.title: Stop this run?
confirm.body: Restore points already written stay in the repository and remain restorable; the work this run had not finished is discarded, so the next run reads it again. The job itself, its schedule and its history are unchanged.

requested.title: Stop requested
requested.description: The appliance is winding {{job}} down — it finishes at the next checkpoint.

failed.title: Couldn't stop the run
failed.description: {{job}} is still running — the appliance didn't take the request. Try again in a moment.

routeError.title: This view hit a snag
routeError.fallback: Something went wrong rendering this view.

staleBuild.title: This view needs a reload
staleBuild.description: The appliance was updated while this console was open, so the page it tried to load is no longer on the server. Reloading picks up the current version.

replication.title: Replication isn’t available on this appliance
replication.description: This build backs up and restores; it does not keep a running replica on a second host. The link you followed is from a console that does. Nothing is broken and nothing is lost — your backup jobs and restore points are unaffected.

notPermitted.title: Your role doesn't include this page
notPermitted.description: The appliance only lets each role use the functions assigned to it, and none of what this page shows is assigned to yours. If you need it, ask an Administrator to change your role.

resize.hint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

resourceName.whitespace: A name can't start or end with a space — remove it or use a different character.
resourceName.charset: Start with a letter or number, then use only Latin letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
